title: Flamingo reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- flamingo body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='62' rx='22' ry='15' fill='#ff6fa5'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='62' rx='22' ry='15' fill='#ff8ec0' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- wing shading -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='60' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#ff4d8d'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M58 54 C66 44 64 32 56 26' stroke='#ff6fa5' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='54' cy='22' r='9' fill='#ff7fb2'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M46 22 L34 26 L46 29 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <path d='M46 27 L35 28 L46 30 Z' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='20' r='2.2' fill='#3a1f4d'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M42 76 L40 90' stroke='#ff5c9e' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 76 L54 90' stroke='#ff5c9e' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 90 L34 92 M40 90 L46 92' stroke='#ff4d8d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 90 L48 92 M54 90 L60 92' stroke='#ff4d8d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <rect x='60' y='58' width='26' height='20' rx='2' fill='#3fc1e8'/>
  <rect x='60' y='58' width='26' height='20' rx='2' fill='#7fe0f5' opacity='0.3'/>
  <path d='M73 58 L73 78' stroke='#e8fbff' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M64 63 L70 63 M64 67 L70 67 M64 71 L70 71' stroke='#e8fbff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 63 L82 63 M76 67 L82 67 M76 71 L82 71' stroke='#e8fbff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- wing tips holding book -->
  <path d='M56 62 L62 62' stroke='#ff4d8d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
